notes.title: Tiny Teams 2024 Festival
notes.content:
[h1]Owl Observatory Selected for Tiny Teams 2024 Festival![/h1]

I am thrilled to announce that Owl Observatory has been selected for the Tiny Teams 2024 Festival! 🎉

This festival celebrates games made by solo developers and micro-studios, featuring everything from popular indie hits to hidden gems and potential future blockbusters.
Alongside [i]Owl Observatory[/i], you'll discover other great games on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TinyTeams2024]official event page[/url].

Here's what you need to know:
[list]
[*] [i]Tiny Teams 2024[/i] runs from August 8th to 15th.
[*] [i]Owl Observatory[/i] will be featured on [i]Monday, August 12th, from 2 PM to 5 PM BST[/i] on  [url=twitch.tv/yogscast]twitch[/url].
[/list] 

Check out the event and discover some fantastic indie games!
